name: Leon
desc: A tired American night security guard in his mid-forties, 1999: a low, quiet, slightly hoarse male voice, speaking softly and close into a handheld camcorder microphone, calm on the surface but uneasy, General American accent, no drama. Clear recording.
text: Night log. December first. One forty A.M. First shift. Monitor nine. Fitting room three. Someone's in there. Hello? The mall is closed. Nobody. There's nobody here.
